task: Predict PBRM1 mutation status in clear cell renal cell carcinoma of the kidney. Classes: wildtype vs. mutant. On H&E, PBRM1-mutant tumors often retain classic clear cell architecture but may show altered stromal and vascular patterns and lower-grade conventional morphology compared with more aggressive high-grade tumors.

classes.0: PBRM1 wildtype clear cell renal cell carcinoma with morphology less suggestive of classic lower-grade conventional clear cell pattern.
classes.1: PBRM1 mutant clear cell renal cell carcinoma with relatively conventional clear cell morphology, delicate vasculature, and often lower-grade appearance.
